summary_md: **Nobuaki KUWABARA ([@NobuakiKuwabara](https://x.com/NobuakiKuwabara/status/2116773225158136081))** shares *Program-as-Weights* by Zhang et al. ([arXiv 2607.02512](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02512)), which compiles natural-language specs for fuzzy functions into adapters for a small local interpreter model, reporting 0.6B-scale results comparable to prompting Qwen3-32B.

relevance: Compiling specs into small local models.
